title: 雲の向こう、宙のかなた

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I visit the library with Admire Vega, but she suddenly disappears.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's dangerous to use the step ladder like that. Remember, you're an Umamusume before a librarian.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: R-right!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Okay, I have to do my best to be careful… for the success of the Meteor Shower Corner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meteor shower? That reminds me, I saw something on TV about one happening soon. The library must be preparing something for it.
choice_data_list: Your special event corner looks fun.
Your special event corner looks fun.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's not even complete yet.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: This book or that book… I wonder which one is easier to understand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Another day, I'm headed out to do some research alone when…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: There must be something I can do to thank you for helping me out again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't need anything. Rather, you should keep working.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Give me half of those papers. I'll cut them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: U-um… Thank you again! You're even helping me with my description texts!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm just seeing this through to the end. Besides, you seemed a little stuck.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah… I'm supposed to be researching, but I keep getting drawn in by the mythology.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …I can see that. You're often reading stories about heroes at the checkout counter.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Look, it says "Meteor Shower Corner"! That reminds me, we'll be able to see one soon, right?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: The academy is supposed to be a great spot to see it! Maybe reading up beforehand will make it more fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The display corner is finally complete. I'm looking forward to the day of the event and seeing how much their work together pays off. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the meteor shower… I see Zenno Rob Roy staring gloomily at the rain running down the windows.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haha… The weather can't be helped. We'll have to look forward to the next opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: All the visitors to our special corner must be really disappointed too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Was all our work really for nothing?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The books we selected, the crafts we struggled to make, not to mention the time spent writing out explanations on the poster.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Even if the sky is blocked out by clouds, the stars and our efforts don't just disappear.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You're right! I…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: We learned so much prepping for this event. Like about meteor showers that come from afar and the fascinating heroes represented in constellations…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ayabe, thank you! I'll be back!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: "Stargazing Without the Stars"? Wow, this sounds interesting! Can we join?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Even if we can't see the stars, we can still talk about them.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: True, we already learned so much just by reading. By the way, I came across a funnily named meteor shower! It's called Hair Strands.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So this is what she came up with. A meeting in the library for talking about stars… In other words, "Stargazing Without the Stars."
choice_data_list: You really came through in the end.
Do you have any tips about stargazing to tell them?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: This wasn't my idea.
choice_data_list: But what you said motivated her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sure, but she's the one who made it happen. This is all her doing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Quit looking at me like that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I must not have done a very good job hiding my smile. Her expression does look less severe now though.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Stargazing tips? I wanna know!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: We want to be able to see the meteor shower next time! How should we go about starting?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I want to know too! If it's not too much trouble…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega begins to quietly speak. Although somewhat blunt, she carefully explains while the Umamusume around her listen in silence.
